# Kortex

> Kortex starts with a free SEO and AI visibility audit (https://visibility.kortexagent.co): it puts 20 questions a company's customers ask to ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude, reads Google's page one and AI Overview for its searches, checks the site, shows who is named instead and writes four fixes (an article, an FAQ, llms.txt and structured data). Then the Kortex agent runs live checks, writes the posts that get the company named, checks again every week and works inside Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. The same agent reads competitors' Facebook and Instagram ads (Kortex Compete), watches them daily, and makes new image ads from the company's own products, in its look, ready for Ads Manager. Every account starts with 50 free credits.

Kortex also makes an AI ad agent for Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads, in early access: every day it reads the ad account, finds where return on ad spend (ROAS) is leaking and proposes the exact fix, which a person approves. The ads agent is free while it is in early access.

## What the Kortex ads agent does

- Checks Meta Ads and Google Ads accounts daily for wasted spend: fatigued creatives, placements and audiences that spend without returns, budgets on the wrong campaigns.
- Proposes fixes with the numbers behind them: pause or resume ads, ad sets and campaigns; change budgets (a single change can at most double or halve a budget); adjust placements and audiences; launch new ad sets and ads.
- Never changes an ad account without approval. Proposals nobody approves expire, and anything new Kortex creates in Meta starts paused.
- Makes image ads from a brand's products, in its colours and type, and launches them paused for review.
- Answers questions about the ad account in plain language.
- Connects through Meta's and Google's own sign-in screens; Kortex never sees a password.

Coming soon: Shopify, TikTok Ads and ChatGPT Ads.

## Pricing

- Free: one full SEO and AI visibility audit per website, with the four written fixes and no card, and 50 free credits for the agent.
- Growth: $50 a month, or ₹4,999 a month in India. Weekly checks with a Monday email of what changed, live checks with ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google, blog, Medium, LinkedIn and Reddit posts, competitor ad reports and daily watching, new ads from the company's products, and Kortex inside Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, with a monthly usage allowance and top-ups.
- The ads agent for Meta Ads and Google Ads: free during early access, and nothing charged on ad spend.
- Details: [Pricing](https://kortexagent.co/pricing) and [pricing.md](https://kortexagent.co/pricing.md).

## Free tools

- [Visibility](https://visibility.kortexagent.co): checks whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google recommend a business when its customers ask, who they name instead, and what to fix.
- [Compete](https://compete.kortexagent.co): reads competitors' live ads from the Meta Ad Library and explains what they are running.
- [Creators](https://creators.kortexagent.co): finds Instagram creators who fit what a brand sells, for partnership ads.
